note: Audience level per lab. HAND-JUDGED from each lab's own README and card copy, never from its name. Levels: beginner (no maths beyond arithmetic), intermediate (comfortable with algebra and basic modular arithmetic), advanced (expects the underlying maths: groups, fields, lattices). Renamed from school-14/school-18 on 2026-10-03; the ASSIGNMENTS did not change, only what they are called. On 2026-10-03 a second pass read the LIVE PAGE of all 76 intermediate labs -- intro and first exhibit, as a visitor sees them -- and moved 22 to beginner; the reading, the test applied and the 16 near misses that stayed are in audits/BEGINNER-ONRAMP-2026-10-03.md. Edit this file, then run `node tools/level-sync.js` to stamp the cards and regenerate LEVELS-REVIEW.md.
